name: @aop/edge-proxy
description: AOP zero-latency Cloudflare Worker edge proxy. Sits between AI shopping agents (ACP/AP2) and headless Shopify/BigCommerce origins: transparently proxies all traffic, intercepts intent endpoints (/availability, /shipping_quote) to emit telemetry into the EDGE_LOG_QUEUE Cloudflare Queue, and batches queue messages via HTTPS into the AOP ingestion service. No runtime dependencies by design: the worker must stay tiny to hold the <5ms overhead budget, and tests run on plain Node (node --test) with no network or wrangler required.
